Hello! I'm sure I'm overlooking something somewhere but...

The Throwing Knives attack says "This attack may attack two different targets." Does this require the player to split their attack dice between the two targets, or do the 3 attack dice (potentially) hit both targets?

Thanks for any help. Really enjoying this game (we've played a couple of skirmishes so far to get warmed up and get the rules ironed out... next stop is the Scenarios!)

Paul

Does this require the player to split their attack dice between the two targets, or do the 3 attack dice (potentially) hit both targets?Thanks for any help. The one attack roll hits both targets. You don't have to split the dice. (Note that Aim and Attack +1 tokens only affect a single target as normal.)
